description:
[Game reference] Every horse breed: gallop speed, health and spawn chance, fastest first. One row per breed, fastest first: `speed_mult` (multiplies the gallop only), `gallop_kmh` / `gallop_ms` with no gear,
`gallop_road_kmh` on a road or railway, `best_kmh` (High Quality Horse Shoes + road + apple boost), `hp`,
`spawn_pct` (breeds are rolled at random when a horse spawns; horses can't be bred). Answers "which horse is fastest". Use for 'which horse is fastest' / 'best horse breed'. Breed multiplies only the gallop; walk, trot and canter are the same for all. Horses can't be bred. Link https://rust.wiki/horses#breeds.
name: get_horse_breeds
